'''R2-C4''' was an [[astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]. During the [[Imperial Era]] it served [[Alderaan]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], providing cover for him while in a secret meeting with fellow Senator [[Riyo Chuchi]] of [[Pantora]].<ref name="CC">{{TBB|The Clone Conspiracy}}</ref> R2-C4 later notified Chuchi that Organa wished to see her, and it took her to meet him and their associates, [[Clone Force 99]], who had arrived on [[Coruscant]] to assist him in obtaining proof of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]]'s wrongdoings.<ref name="TC">{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R2-C4 is incorrectly referred to as [[R2-D2]] in the audio description for "[[Truth and Consequences]]."<ref name="TC AD">{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>
